title: Vallée on Ransone's NRO satellite work

tellings.quote: that he he spoke with her back in that late '70s time and she was doing some sort of work for the NRO and um

plain: In the late 1970s, around Houston, a woman named Valerie Ransone was doing some kind of work for the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, according to the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée, who says he spoke with her then. An unnamed researcher on the show summarises this from Vallée's published journals, Forbidden Science, without going into more detail, and offers it as a sign that she had ties to intelligence work.
